description: The deck BUILD M8 names for spec 02, card for card: #7 Jewelosco Scarab (discover), #16 Hit Job (target), #17 Flood (mode, on its radiant face), #30 Archivist (mode, the second source), #26 Glowy Jelly Bean (hand - and the card that makes Flood radiant), #67 Zoomerbin Oomen (zone), #55 Lava Golem (tribute), #52 Silly Silas (direction), #24 Efficiency Dividend (x) and #46 Suppressive Aura (embiggen); the opening mulligan is the tenth picker and needs no card. The other ten are the bodies those pickers need: #15 Me and Mr Token is two units for one mana, #3, #8, #11, #20, #25, #45 and #91 are cheap units that fill the board so Lava Golem's Tribute 3 has more than one minimal paying set (R101, R123) and Hit Job has a unit to destroy, and #5 Stockpile and #10 Rapid Replenish are the only two cards here that ask nothing at all. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand. #5099: #8 Mr. Vanilla, #11 Tempo Timmy, #20 Pointmaster and #25 4-mana 7/7, a card whose whole text is its keyword line, are dealt as stand-ins (crates/engine/src/testkit/stand_in.rs) spelling their numbers as they stood, in the same place in the list, so the deal is unchanged and no balance patch moves them.
cards: stand-in (1) 3/3 Rush, First Strike R6/6 Charge, First Strike
